results.question: What is our total revenue?

cards.title: Total Revenue (USD)
cards.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(net_amount_usd), 0) AS total_revenue_usd FROM core.fct_order_lines

results.question: What was the gross revenue in 2023?

cards.title: Gross Revenue 2023
cards.sql: SELECT round(sum(gross_amount_usd)) AS gross_revenue FROM core.fct_order_lines WHERE extract(year from order_date) = 2023

results.question: How many orders were placed in 2024?

cards.title: Orders in 2024
cards.sql: select count(distinct order_key) as total_orders from core.fct_order_lines where extract(year from order_date) = 2024

results.question: How many customers do we have?

cards.title: Total Customers
cards.sql: SELECT count(customer_key) AS total_customers FROM core.dim_customer

results.question: How many customers bought something in 2025?

cards.title: Active Customers in 2025
cards.sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT customer_key) AS active_customers FROM core.fct_order_lines WHERE order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND order_date <= '2025-12-31'

results.question: What is the average delivery time in days?

cards.title: Average Delivery Time in Days
cards.sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(delivery_days), 2) as avg_delivery_days FROM core.fct_order_lines

results.question: How many orders took more than 7 days to deliver?

cards.title: Orders Taking More Than 7 Days to Deliver
cards.sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT order_key) AS delayed_orders_count FROM core.fct_order_lines WHERE delivery_days > 7

results.question: What is the net revenue of the online store compared to physical stores?

cards.title: Net Revenue by Sales Channel
cards.sql: SELECT s.sales_channel AS channel, ROUND(SUM(f.net_amount_usd), 0) AS net_revenue FROM core.fct_order_lines f JOIN core.dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key GROUP BY s.sales_channel ORDER BY net_revenue DESC

results.question: What is the net revenue from orders of customers paying in euros, expressed in euros?

cards.title: Total Net Revenue in Euros
cards.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(net_amount_local), 0) AS net_revenue_eur FROM core.fct_order_lines WHERE currency_code = 'EUR'

cards.title: Net Revenue in Euros by Year
cards.sql: SELECT d.year AS year, ROUND(SUM(f.net_amount_local), 0) AS net_revenue_eur FROM core.fct_order_lines f JOIN core.dim_date d ON f.order_date = d.date_day WHERE f.currency_code = 'EUR' GROUP BY d.year ORDER BY d.year ASC

results.question: Which 3 product categories had the highest margin in 2025, and how much was it?

cards.title: Top 3 Product Categories by Margin in 2025
cards.sql: SELECT p.category_name AS category_name, ROUND(SUM(f.margin_amount_usd), 0) AS total_margin_usd FROM core.fct_order_lines f INNER JOIN core.dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key INNER JOIN core.dim_date d ON f.order_date = d.date_day WHERE d.year = 2025 GROUP BY p.category_name ORDER BY total_margin_usd DESC LIMIT 3

results.question: What share of gross revenue do we give away in discounts?

cards.title: Overall Discount Share
cards.sql: SELECT round(sum(discount_amount_usd) / nullif(sum(gross_amount_usd), 0), 4) as discount_share FROM core.fct_order_lines

cards.title: Gross Revenue vs Discounts Over Time
cards.sql: SELECT d.year_month_short as month, round(sum(f.gross_amount_usd), 0) as gross_revenue_usd, round(sum(f.discount_amount_usd), 0) as discount_amount_usd FROM core.fct_order_lines f JOIN core.dim_date d ON f.order_date = d.date_day GROUP BY d.year_month_number, d.year_month_short ORDER BY d.year_month_number

results.question: What is the margin rate of each product category?

cards.title: Margin Rate by Product Category
cards.sql: SELECT p.category_name, round(sum(f.margin_amount_usd) / nullif(sum(f.net_amount_usd), 0), 4) AS margin_rate FROM core.fct_order_lines f INNER JOIN core.dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key GROUP BY p.category_name ORDER BY margin_rate DESC

results.question: How many stores do we have?

cards.title: Total Stores
cards.sql: SELECT count(*) AS total_stores FROM core.dim_store

results.question: How many stores are open today?

cards.title: Open Stores Today
cards.sql: SELECT count(*) AS open_stores FROM core.dim_store WHERE status = 'Open' AND is_current_version = true

results.question: How did net revenue develop year by year?

cards.title: Net Revenue by Year
cards.sql: SELECT d.year AS year, ROUND(SUM(f.net_amount_usd), 0) AS net_revenue FROM core.fct_order_lines f JOIN core.dim_date d ON f.order_date = d.date_day GROUP BY d.year ORDER BY d.year ASC

results.question: What was the average order value in 2024?

cards.title: Average Order Value (2024)
cards.sql: SELECT round(avg(order_total), 2) AS average_order_value FROM (SELECT order_key, sum(net_amount_usd) AS order_total FROM core.fct_order_lines WHERE extract(year from order_date) = 2024 GROUP BY order_key) t

cards.title: Average Order Value by Month (2024)
cards.sql: SELECT d.year_month_short AS month, round(avg(t.order_total), 2) AS average_order_value FROM (SELECT order_key, order_date, sum(net_amount_usd) AS order_total FROM core.fct_order_lines WHERE extract(year from order_date) = 2024 GROUP BY order_key, order_date) t JOIN core.dim_date d ON t.order_date = d.date_day GROUP BY d.year_month_number, d.year_month_short ORDER BY d.year_month_number

results.question: How much net revenue came from customers who were younger than 30 when they ordered?

cards.title: Net Revenue from Under-30 Customers
cards.sql: SELECT round(sum(net_amount_usd), 0) AS net_revenue_usd FROM core.fct_order_lines WHERE customer_age < 30

cards.title: Net Revenue by Age Group
cards.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN customer_age < 20 THEN 'Under 20' WHEN customer_age BETWEEN 20 AND 29 THEN '20-29' WHEN customer_age BETWEEN 30 AND 39 THEN '30-39' WHEN customer_age BETWEEN 40 AND 49 THEN '40-49' ELSE '50+' END AS age_group, round(sum(net_amount_usd), 0) AS net_revenue_usd FROM core.fct_order_lines GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY net_revenue_usd DESC

results.question: Customers from which country generated the most net revenue, and how much?

cards.title: Top Countries by Net Revenue
cards.sql: SELECT c.country_name AS country, round(sum(f.net_amount_usd), 0) AS net_revenue_usd FROM core.fct_order_lines f JOIN core.dim_customer c ON f.customer_key = c.customer_key GROUP BY c.country_name ORDER BY net_revenue_usd DESC LIMIT 10

results.question: How much net revenue was made on working days and how much on other days?

cards.title: Net Revenue by Working Day Status
cards.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN d.is_working_day THEN 'Working Day' ELSE 'Non-Working Day' END AS working_day_status, ROUND(SUM(f.net_amount_usd), 0) AS net_revenue FROM core.fct_order_lines f INNER JOIN core.dim_date d ON f.order_date = d.date_day GROUP BY d.is_working_day ORDER BY net_revenue DESC

results.question: Which 5 brands sold the most units?

cards.title: Top 5 Brands by Units Sold
cards.sql: SELECT p.brand AS brand, SUM(l.quantity) AS units_sold FROM core.fct_order_lines l INNER JOIN core.dim_product p ON l.product_key = p.product_key GROUP BY p.brand ORDER BY units_sold DESC LIMIT 5
